newsitem.title: USA: Acme United taking Q3 charge of $580,000.
newsitem.headline: Acme United taking Q3 charge of $580,000.

text.p: Acme United Corp said Wednesday that will take a one-time charge of $580,000 in the third quarter.
The company said it had projected a profitable third quarter. It reported a second quarter loss of $1.2 million or $0.37 per share.

The charge will cover severance payments for Dwight Wheeler, its vice chairman, secretery and treasurer, and Ian Sloan, senior vice president and managing director of Acme United Ltd, the company said. The company announced the resignations and their replacements Wedensday.
The company said the charge to cover the severance payments "will adversely affect third quarter earnings."
